previous_statement: Operation upgrade: the transported polar and group-defect guards apply lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws, defining sigma(U)=u_delta(U^dagger) on all calU for the unique inverse component identified in node 1.3. This result and node 1.5.1 are precisely the three antecedents named by lem-stage1-smooth-unitary-operations: approximate group laws, smooth unitary atlas, and smooth polar inverse. Therefore that external makes the same sigma smooth as a self-map of calU and explicitly changes no point or first derivative; in particular sigma is the global C^1 map required by node 1.
